Implement the visual/asset integration lane for a DEFAULT mobile steering wheel in Racing26. Assume the lead will provide or download a permissively licensed steering-wheel image/SVG into public/assets. Build the component/CSS so it uses a real wheel asset (not arrow buttons), rotates responsively with analog steering input, remains crisp on high-DPI phones/tablets, has sensible fallback styling if the asset fails, and does not intercept unrelated pedal touches. Also harden global drag behavior: disable text selection, image drag, callout/tap highlights, and overscroll/browser gestures during play without breaking settings buttons. Keep changes scoped to src/public/index.html and add tests where practical. Do not modify vehicle physics or tire grip.
